item.title: Art in Bloom Celebrates 20 Years - Classic 107.3
item.description: Amanda Thompson Rundahl, the Director of Learning and Engagement for the Saint Louis Art Museum, tells listeners about the history of Art in Bloom, which is happening February 27-March 1. Hear about how art works and floral artists are selected, and learn about some of the special events associated with the 20th Art in Bloom at SLAM. Learn more at https://www.slam.org/event/art-in-bloom-2026/ Classic 107.3 · Art in Bloom Celebrates 20 Years

item.title: A Conversation with Nic McGegan - Classic 107.3
item.description: Hear Nic McGegan’s fascinating conversation with Chamber Music Society of St. Louis Executive and Artistic Director Marc Gordon and Kathy Lawton Brown. Beloved by St Louis audiences, Maestro McGegan returns on March 9, 2026, for an unforgettable evening of music with the CMSSL featuring works by Georg Phillip Telemann, Johann Sebastian Bach, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, and Joseph Haydn. Special ticket offer! Learn more and reserve tickets at chambermusicstl.org. Classic 107.3 · A Conversation with

item.title: Leila Josefowicz on Alban Berg's Violin Concerto with the SLSO - Classic 107.3
item.description: Violinist Leila Josefowicz, who will appear with the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra on March 14 and 15, talks about her experiences with the SLSO, her musical ideology, and explains why Alban Berg’s Violin Concerto has been such an important part of her life. For more information and tickets for this weekend’s concerts, visit slso.org/event/scheherazade-magic-and-myth/ Classic 107.3 · Leila Josefowicz on Alban Berg's Violin Concerto with the SLSO

item.title: The Playlist - Station News - Classic 107.3
item.description: The Playlist – Station News – https://mailchi.mp/classic1073.org/the-playlist-march-9-2026 Interviews this week feature violinist Leila Josefowicz, who’ll be performing with the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra this weekend, and pianist Brian Woods, who will discuss the upcoming Celebration of Women Composers at the World Chess Hall of Fame & Galleries. Plus, local programs celebrate St. Patrick’s Day and Women’s History Month! Discover what’s happening on the Voice for the Arts in St. Louis.

item.title: On the Art with SLAM - Seated Woman with Melissa Wolfe - Classic 107.3
item.description: Hear from Melissa Wolfe, Curator of American Art at the Saint Louis Art Museum, about Seated Woman, a wood sculpture created by Elizabeth Catlett in 1962. Enjoy related music from composer Wiliam Grant Still. Learn more at https://www.slam.org/collection/objects/65202/ Classic 107.3 · On the Art with SLAM – Seated Woman with Melissa Wolfe

item.title: On the Art with SLAM - Figure of a Mother and Child with Nichole N. Bridges - Classic 107.3
item.description: Hear from Nichole N. Bridges, the Morton D. May Curator of the Arts of Africa, Oceania and the Americas at the Saint Louis Art Museum, about Figure of a Mother and Child. Enjoy related music from Florence Price. Learn more at https://www.slam.org/collection/objects/17583/ Classic 107.3 · On the Art with SLAM – Figure of a Mother and Child with Nichole N. Bridges

item.title: Creating a Cinematic Community - St. Louis Jewish Film Festival - Classic 107.3
item.description: Hear from John Wilson, the Director of Cultural Arts for the Jewish Community Center of St. Louis, about the 31st Annual St. Louis Jewish Film Festival, happening March 15–26. Learn more at https://stljewishfilmfestival.org Classic 107.3 · Creating a Cinematic Community – St. Louis Jewish Film Festival

item.title: Paolo Alderighi and Stephanie Trick Swing Into Spring - Classic 107.3
item.description: The Chamber Music Society of St. Louis Executive and Artistic Director Marc Gordon and jazz piano duo Paolo Alderighi and Stephanie Trick talk with Kathy Lawton Brown about “Swing Into Spring” with the Chamber Music Society of St. Louis on March 30, 2026. Learn more and reserve tickets at chambermusicstl.org/concerts/swing-into-spring. Classic 107.3 · Swing Into Spring with the Chamber Music Society of St. Louis

item.title: Víkíngur Ólafsson Brings Beethoven to St. Louis - Classic 107.3
item.description: Pianist Víkíngur Ólafsson returns to St. Louis for performances with the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra as well as a solo recital. Hear from Víkíngur about why the music of Ludwig van Beethoven connects with audiences (and why Stéphane Denève is a great Beethoven conductor) and learn the secret for getting modern audiences interested in classical music. item.title: St. Louis Symphony Preview: Beethoven's Emperor Concerto - Classic 107.3
item.description: Co-hosts Tom Sudholt and Chuck Lavazzi discuss the St. Louis Symphony Orchestra‘s program for this weekend. Beethoven’s Emperor Concerto — Radiant Vision with performances on March 27 and 28. Pianist Víkingur Ólafsson in Recital is happening on March 26. Learn more and purchase tickets at slso.org/event/beethovens-emperor-concerto-radiant-vision. Find Chuck Lavazzi’s review for St. Louis Arts Scene at stlouisarts.substack.com.
